description: Ley 25.326 de Protección de Datos Personales (Argentina)
full_name: Ley 25.326 de Protección de Datos Personales
regulator: AAIP (Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública)
regulator_full_name: Agencia de Acceso a la Información Pública (formerly DNPDP/AEPD)

young_child.description: Parental or guardian consent required for children under 13 for all processing

child.description: Parental or guardian consent required for persons 13-15 for non-essential processing

teen.description: Persons 16-17 may consent independently; parental consent recommended for sensitive data

adult.description: Explicit consent from data subject required; consent must be free, informed, and unambiguous

secondary_threshold_note: Parental consent required for non-essential processing for persons under 16
special_categories_note: Processing of sensitive personal data is prohibited without explicit consent or specific legal justification; health data may only be collected by healthcare professionals or appropriate institutions

right_to_access.description: Data subject may request confirmation of whether their data is held and obtain a copy at no charge

right_to_rectification.description: Data subject may request correction of inaccurate or incomplete personal data within 5 business days

right_to_deletion.description: Data subject may request deletion (suppression) of personal data where processing is unlawful or data is unnecessary

right_to_objection.description: Data subject may object to processing of personal data for legitimate reasons, including direct marketing

database_registration.description: Personal data databases (archivos) must be registered with the AAIP National Registry of Personal Data Databases

privacy_impact_assessment.description: Privacy Impact Assessment recommended for high-risk or sensitive data processing

parental_consent.description: Parental or guardian consent mandatory for children under 13 for all data processing

parental_consent_non_essential.description: Parental or guardian consent required for persons under 16 for non-essential processing

right_to_access.description: Must provide access to personal data within 30 days of request at no charge

right_to_deletion.description: Must delete or correct personal data within 5 business days of a valid request

data_breach_notification.description: Must notify AAIP of security incidents affecting personal data; notification of affected persons required where risk is significant

sensitive_data_prohibition.description: Processing of sensitive personal data (health, ethnic origin, political opinion, sexual life) is prohibited without explicit consent

data_quality.description: Data must be accurate, relevant, and up to date; must not be kept longer than necessary for the collection purpose

cross_border_transfers.description: Argentina has EU adequacy status (since 2003). Transfers to countries without adequate protection require explicit consent or contractual safeguards. Transfers to countries on the prohibited list require AAIP authorisation.

location_data.description: Location data requires explicit consent and short retention periods

automatic_decision_making.description: Automated decisions that significantly affect data subjects require human review and right of challenge

profiling.description: Profiling of children and automated profiling for non-educational purposes prohibited

biometric_data.description: Biometric data requires explicit consent and heightened security measures

warnings: Argentina's PDPA (Ley 25.326) has EU adequacy status — it offers comparable protection to GDPR
Personal data databases (archivos) must be registered with the AAIP National Registry
Parental consent required for children under 13 for all processing
Parental consent required for persons under 16 for non-essential processing
Sensitive personal data (health, ethnic origin, political opinion, sexual life) cannot be processed without explicit consent
Data subjects may request access, rectification, deletion, or suppression of their data
Rectification and deletion must be completed within 5 business days
Cross-border transfers to countries without adequate protection require AAIP authorisation
Fines for violations can reach up to ARS $3M and include criminal liability in serious cases
requirements: Register all personal data databases (archivos) with the AAIP National Registry of Personal Data Databases
Obtain explicit parental consent before collecting data from children under 13
Obtain parental consent for non-essential processing of data from persons under 16
Obtain explicit consent before processing sensitive personal data
Establish lawful basis for each personal data processing activity
Implement a process to respond to access requests within 30 days at no charge
Implement a process to respond to rectification and deletion requests within 5 business days
Maintain a data breach response plan and notify AAIP of significant incidents
Apply data quality principles: accuracy, relevance, and minimum necessary retention
Implement technical and organisational security measures appropriate to the risk of processing
